name: Kilo Code (Always-Free Models)
highlights: Ongoing zero-cost coding models built right into Kilo Code with zero subscription required plus seamless Kilo Gateway :free routing.
limits_note: Ongoing free coding models inside Kilo Code
signup_note: Install the Kilo Code extension and select a built-in free model — no credit card required.

name: OpenRouter :free + Tool Calling
highlights: Single OpenAI-compatible API key accessing ongoing zero-cost :free models (DeepSeek, Qwen3, Devstral, GPT-OSS) with explicit tool-support metadata.
limits_note: 20 RPM / 50 RPD recurring (1,000 RPD w/ $10 one-time credit)
signup_note: No credit card required; pass `:free` model IDs to any OpenAI-compatible agent or custom code.

name: OpenCode Free / Zen Models
highlights: Built-in zero-cost coding models curated directly inside OpenCode TUI for instant terminal agent runs.
limits_note: Rate-limited ongoing free endpoints inside OpenCode
signup_note: Run `opencode` and pick the built-in free provider preset or bring an OpenRouter/Groq key.

name: Gemini CLI (Free Google OAuth)
highlights: Official terminal coding agent backed by personal Google OAuth login with 1M context window and generous daily request allowance.
limits_note: Up to ~1,000 RPD free inside Gemini CLI
signup_note: Install via npm and sign in with a personal Google account (separate from AI Studio Direct API limits).

name: Qwen Code CLI (Free OAuth)
highlights: Open-source terminal coding CLI tuned for Qwen Coder models with a generous free daily OAuth quota.
limits_note: Ongoing daily free coding quota via Qwen OAuth
signup_note: Sign in via Qwen OAuth inside `qwen` CLI — no credit card required.

name: Nous Portal (Hermes Agent)
highlights: Free hosted inference portal tailored for Hermes Agent autonomous loops, tool calling, and multi-turn coding.
limits_note: Ongoing community quota via Nous Research Portal sign-in
signup_note: Connect via Hermes Agent CLI (`hermes setup`) or Nous Portal OAuth.

name: Freebuff (Codebuff Free Mode)
highlights: Zero-cost agentic coding mode backed by fast open-weight models for multi-file edits and repo navigation.
limits_note: Daily recurring free agentic session allowance
signup_note: Select Freebuff mode inside Codebuff CLI with no credit card required.

name: Groq LPU Free Tier
highlights: Sub-second time-to-first-token and 1,000 RPD recurring daily across Llama, Qwen, and GPT-OSS models with zero data training.
limits_note: 30 RPM / 1,000 RPD recurring daily (direct REST endpoint)
signup_note: Free key with no credit card required.

name: Cerebras ($5 One-Time Credit)
highlights: Ultra-fast wafer-scale token speeds (~1,800+ tok/s) for edit-test-fix loops, funded by a one-time $5 signup credit.
signup_note: Trial credit only — not a recurring ongoing free tier.
